settings.content: Pitriciacle palette — champagne is for accents only; porcelain is the dominant ground.
Headlines: Cormorant Garamond (300–600 + italics). Body & micro-labels: Jost (300–500). Loaded in layout/theme.liquid with display=swap.
Micro-labels (kickers) are uppercase Jost at 0.22em letter-spacing. Body text always renders in Ink; Stone is reserved for large or muted text only.
When no logo is uploaded, the brand name is typeset in Cormorant Garamond as the wordmark.
Checkout styling is managed in the Shopify admin under Settings → Checkout. Keep the checkout palette aligned: porcelain ground, ink text, champagne accents.
